title: Trail runner leaping a mountain stream

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. He is caught mid-leap over a fast mountain stream, one trail shoe planted on a wet boulder and the other in the air, spray thrown up around the sole and frozen in the light. He wears a sleeveless burnt-orange running vest, black split running shorts and the trail shoes. Overcast alpine light, dark wet granite and a pale green valley falling away behind. 35mm from low beside the water, full length, fast shutter, his face set and focused.
